project.name: A Tool That Runs
project.goal: Build me a small command-line tool in this project's workspace, in Python, using the standard library only: A TOOL THAT TAKES A FOLDER OF MARKDOWN FILES AND REPORTS BROKEN RELATIVE LINKS. Replace that with the tool I actually want before planning. It must have a --help that explains itself in one screen, sensible behaviour on the boring cases (no arguments, an empty folder, a file it cannot read), a non-zero exit code when it finds problems so it can be used in a script, and tests written with the standard library's unittest that run with no installation step. Standard library only, on purpose: a fresh container runs the tests, so anything pip-installed during a run will not be there when the check runs.
